title: Task Layout Changes
description:
The attachments should use a simple + button with tooltip, and give more horizontal space to the searchable combobox
Uploading a screenshot with other text changes (description) wipes those changes
Difficult to use the comments/artifacts/history section, as it does not resize and I cannot scroll down into it (I can only scroll the tiny view area).
New task description should fill the area down to the buttons
Upload file button should not line break, and highlight is not fully covering it
Image uploads (and possibly text) should preview on hover (if enabled in config). Needs to have filesize/dimension bounds to avoid preview attempts on massive files. Needs link highlighting (it's clickable, just not color-coded).

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: This report currently bundles several distinct task-workbench issues: attachment affordances (`+` button and tooltip expectations), edit-state loss when uploading attachments alongside description edits, comments/artifacts/history panel sizing/scroll behavior, new-task description height, upload button wrapping/highlight coverage, and optional bounded hover previews for image/text attachments. It is still useful as a capture task, but implementation will go faster if follow-up work either phases these by surface or creates child tasks for composer, layout/scrolling, and preview behavior.
